title: ‘Western troops in Ukraine would mean war with Russia’: Putin ahead of Brics meet
summary_full: President Putin warned that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine would escalate into war with Russia. He refuted claims that Russia poses a threat to European countries, stating that previous disagreements have been settled. Furthermore, he pointed out that the current challenges facing Europe stem from significant political and economic miscalculations by the West.
